decision_policy.any_query_or_document_truncation: abstain; omit rankings/artifact metadata for affected queries (all queries if any document truncates)
decision_policy.ranking: all20 cosine scores; numeric ties ordered by exact identity, never by language or artifact coverage
decision_policy.thresholds: none; no historical thresholds reused or fitted

scope.excluded: No cases, source code, legacy index, protected corpus or full-corpus loaders.
scope.normative_contract_binding: Public contract hashes retained; implementation qualification belongs exclusively to current v4 KnownCatalogue.
scope.not_a_claim: Not global recognition coverage, precision, semantic uniqueness, serving approval, frozen500 M1 or historical calibration equivalence.
scope.population: Exactly six public-domain v1 and fourteen accessible public-domain v2 contracts; no new easy-problem additions.
